title: Beige: Balance Aggregation and Sub-Account Management
summary: This document explains how to set up Beige balance aggregation by linking external accounts (up to 30) for centralized visibility/reporting, then assigning each to an entity/department. It also covers creating up to 50 sub-accounts for department/project/business unit/cost center tagging, including setup practices, permission restrictions, roll-up views, and reconciliation/periodic review procedures.
faqs: How do I connect external accounts in Beige for balance aggregation and reporting?
What is the maximum number of external accounts I can link (and how should I prioritize them)?
How do I create sub-accounts, and what categories can I tag (department/project/business unit/cost center)?
What is the limit on the number of sub-accounts, and why use a consistent naming convention?
How do I restrict permissions so teams can only post/view within their assigned sub-accounts?
After setup, how do I reconcile aggregated balances with institution statements and handle periodic reviews (retire/reassign)?
